title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the Ampere force as 0.28 N using F = BIL with the correct current from Ohm's law.

title: Friction magnitude and direction
description: Essential: Correctly determines the frictional force magnitude (0.04 N) and its direction (down the incline) from force equilibrium.

title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum speed in part (3) as 15 m/s.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law correctly for the initial static equilibrium (Ampere force = gravity component + friction).

title: Dynamic equilibrium setup
description: Important: For part (3), sets up the force balance at terminal velocity (gravity component = Ampere force + kinetic friction).

title: Induced EMF and current
description: Important: Correctly expresses the motional EMF as BLv and the resulting current in the new circuit.

title: Component resolution
description: Optional: Explicitly resolves the gravitational force into components along and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Reverses the direction of the frictional force or the Ampere force in the equilibrium equations.

title: Circuit oversight
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong total resistance when calculating current in part (1) or part (3).

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to use consistent SI units or omits units in final answers.
